our_interpretation: Operationalize means the purchased equipment is installed in powered facilities and performing computing work.
Read the forecast as describing deployment of the sales cohort in aggregate. It does not explicitly say that no individual GPU can operate earlier.
Use calendar 2025 and 2026 as a provisional reading of the unqualified years. Preserve the fiscal/calendar ambiguity rather than treating fiscal 2026 revenue as calendar 2026 revenue.
The exact words describe the construction rate as the basis for the prediction; they do not explicitly require that the rate remain unchanged through 2029.

The explicit construction antecedent is met if relevant GPU-equipped AI facilities are actually built. Evidence of one operating cluster satisfies that limited antecedent but cannot settle aggregate deployment timing.
criteria.support_condition: Matched sales and commissioning records show that deployment of the relevant 2025–2026 GPU sales cohort generally required waiting until 2028–2029, with the claimed advance-purchase spending independently documented.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative, value-weighted records establish that the relevant cohort was largely operational before 2028, or establish a materially different deployment timetable incompatible with the forecast.
